content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler pudding is a gentle toddler dessert made from selected fruits and berries, without added sugar or artificial flavors. Suitable for children from 6 months old, it is easy to digest and helps develop taste preferences.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Produced in small batches to ensure consistent quality.
Contains only 100 % natural ingredients, free from gluten and lactose.
Each pack is made from fruits grown in environmentally clean regions.
The product meets strict safety controls and complies with international infant nutrition standards.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: The pudding provides vitamin C, vitamin A and B‑complex vitamins that support immunity and visual development in toddlers.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy bowel function and helps establish a balanced gut microbiome.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Absence of added sugar helps avoid rapid blood‑glucose spikes.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Its smooth texture and lack of heavy proteins make it an ideal first complementary food.

items.title: Supports growth
items.content: Minerals such as potassium and magnesium aid muscle and nervous system development.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to specific fruits should consult a pediatrician before introducing the product.

items.title: Age restrictions
items.content: Not recommended for infants under 6 months without pediatric guidance.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 48 hours.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pudding straight from the pack, stir into baby cereal or yogurt, or use as a filling for toddler pancakes. Warm gently to a comfortable temperature if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened pack in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and use within 2 days.
